text:
I was very impressed. It's a small clinic, but the doctor explained everything and provided excellent information. The doctor asked many questions, showing genuine concern, not just a couple of questions and then telling me to get medication.

The counter staff were polite and lovely, and gave advice patiently.

The cost of the medication and doctor's fee was surprisingly affordable.

In short, coming here, I saw a doctor, gained knowledge, and received medication for the same price as getting acne treatment!

Highly recommended!
